notes.title: Epic Update for Path Of Sacrifice V 1.00
Updated 2 July 2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Modified the level of Floor 4 to avoid the [i]Death Stare[/i] route getting stuck.
[/list][list]
[*]Filled in some vacancy of background.
[/list][list]
[*]Fixed the bug in game pass settlement.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Modified the collider of ladder to increase fault tolerance.
[/list][list]
[*]Improve the traction speed of [i]Pulling Star[/i].
[/list]

notes.title: Updated 27 June 2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Modify the display bug of sacrifice interface.
[*] Fixed the bug of jumping on a ladder.
[*] Some level details have been modified.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Set the last level of chase to restart after death.
[*] Add the hard core mode of one life clearance, and prompt after the normal difficulty clearance.
[/list]
[b]There will be a large scale update in the next few weeks, with collection elements and skin systems.Please look forward to! [/b]

notes.title: Update on June 24 2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 1.Fixed the bug that jump and interaction are not bound with custom keys.
[/list][list][*] 2.The menu can be operated by keyboard[/list][list][*] 3.The sacrifice interface can be operated by keyboard
[/list]
If you find a bug in the process of playing, please leave a message in time.
